India Introduces Digital Overseas Citizen Card, Updates FCRA Portal

The Indian government has launched an electronic version of the Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, allowing cardholders to download a digital copy and update passport details online. This initiative aims to fully digitize services and streamline compliance for foreign contributions through an upgraded FCRA 2.0 portal. The move is expected to simplify processes for OCI cardholders and foreign contribution management.
